sum_insured_options: Not specified in wording (₹3L – ₹1Cr referenced in tables)

room_rent.display: Silver: 1% SI/day; Gold/Platinum: Single Pvt AC (3L–7.5L), Any room (10L+)
room_rent.note: Silver Plan capped at 1% of SI per day. Gold & Platinum: SI 3L–7.5L = Single Private AC room; SI 10L+ = any room. Optional room-rent capping discount available (1.5% SI/day up to ₹7,500/day). Proportionate deduction applies if higher room taken.

icu.note: ICU charges paid at actual expenses for all plans.

copayment.display: None (base); Zone co-pay if Zone B/C insured treats in higher zone
copayment.note: No mandatory co-pay by default. Zone B insured treating in Zone A: 15%; Zone C in Zone A: 20%; Zone C in Zone B: 5%. Voluntary co-pay of 10% or 20% available for premium discount.

sub_limits.note: Cataract capped at 20% of SI per eye, max ₹1,00,000. Bariatric: 25% SI (Silver), 50% SI max ₹5L (Gold/Platinum). Maternity: Normal ₹15k–₹25k, Caesarean ₹25k–₹35k depending on SI slab.

deductible.note: No mandatory deductible. Voluntary aggregate deductible options: ₹50,000 / ₹1,00,000 / ₹2,00,000 / ₹3,00,000 available for premium discount. Not applied on maternity/newborn claims.

initial_waiting.note: 30-day waiting period for illnesses; not applicable for accidents. Waived after 12 months continuous coverage.

ped_waiting.note: 36 months continuous coverage from first policy inception. Reducible via portability credit from prior insurer.

specific_disease_waiting.note: 27 listed conditions (cataracts, hernia, fistula, stones, etc.) excluded for 24 months. Joint replacement, vertebral surgery, bariatric, Parkinson's etc. excluded for 36 months.

maternity.note: Not covered under Silver Plan. Gold & Platinum: max 2 deliveries/terminations; Normal delivery ₹15k–₹25k, Caesarean ₹25k–₹35k depending on SI. 72-month waiting period from first Health Guard policy inception. Newborn cover included within maternity limit.

cumulative_bonus.display: Up to 100% (Silver & Gold: 10%/yr); Platinum: up to 150% (50%+50%+10%×5)
cumulative_bonus.note: Silver & Gold: 10% per claim-free year, max 100% over 10 years. Platinum (Super Cumulative Bonus): 50%/yr for first 2 years, then 10%/yr for next 5 years, max 150%. Claim reduces bonus by one slab.

restoration.note: Triggered only after full SI (including cumulative bonus) is exhausted. Applicable once per policy year. For Cancer and Kidney Failure: only once in lifetime of insured; for all other conditions: every year. Platinum plan also has Recharge Benefit (20% SI up to ₹5L) for claim exceeding SI.

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalisation expenses for 60 days before admission for same illness/injury.

post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalisation expenses for 90 days after discharge for same illness/injury.

day_care.display: Listed procedures (399+ listed in Annexure I)
day_care.note: Extensive list of day-care procedures covered across ENT, ophthalmology, oncology, urology, orthopaedics, gynaecology, etc. Not all-inclusive; based on listed procedures.

domiciliary.note: No domiciliary hospitalisation benefit mentioned in the policy wording.

ayush.display: Covered up to SI (inpatient, govt/accredited hospitals)
ayush.note: AYUSH inpatient hospitalisation covered up to In-patient Hospitalisation Treatment SI. Must be in government AYUSH hospital or QCI/NABH accredited facility. Minimum 24-hour admission required.

organ_donor.note: Organ donor harvesting expenses covered when recipient's inpatient claim is admitted. Donor must comply with Transplantation of Human Organs Act.

ambulance.note: Road ambulance: up to ₹20,000 per policy year for emergency transfer to nearest hospital or inter-hospital transfer. Air ambulance available as optional add-on for SI ₹5L and above.

modern_treatments.note: Annexure III lists modern treatments including robotic surgery, stereotactic radiosurgery, oral chemotherapy, immunotherapy, intravitreal injections, HIFU, deep brain stimulation, etc. Covered up to base SI.

consumables.display: Not covered (extensive non-medical items list excluded)
consumables.note: Annexure II lists non-payable consumables (gloves, masks, syringes, etc.). No consumables cover rider mentioned.

global_cover.note: Policy explicitly covers treatment within India only. No international/overseas treatment cover available.

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months of coverage (including portability/migration), no claim can be contested except on grounds of established fraud.

grace_period.note: Grace period is 15 days for monthly instalment premium and 30 days for all other payment modes.

free_look.note: 30-day free-look period for new policies only; not applicable on renewals or portability/migration.

portability.note: Portability to other insurers permitted as per IRDAI guidelines with continuity of waiting period credits.

notable_exclusions.display: No overseas treatment; maternity excluded in Silver; IVF/ART excluded; terrorism covered; dental (non-accidental) excluded

optional_riders.display: Air ambulance (SI ₹5L+); Voluntary co-pay (10%/20%); Voluntary aggregate deductible; Room rent capping discount
